prompt: Start from the still. Only the man on the right of the reference is in shot. He keeps the bottle tipped up and swallows twice, his throat working, then drops it from his mouth, wipes his lips with the back of his wrist and stares off across the car park, breathing hard, shoulders rising and falling. The camera is handheld and drifts slowly in towards him. Sound: rain on tarmac and on tent fabric, the crackle of the fire, a car passing on a distant road. No speech, no music. Thanks.
